chunks: 4227 - Amir al-Mu'minin, 'Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him, said:
"Have taqwa of Allah regarding what He has entrusted to you, and regarding the 'ajm among your possessions."
So it was said to him, "What is al-'ujm?" He said, "The sheep, the cow, the pigeons, and the like of that."

key_terms.اتَّقُوا: Have taqwa; be mindful and fearful of Allah in conduct
key_terms.الْعُجْمِ: Mute animals or non-speaking creatures among one's property
key_terms.خَوَّلَكُمْ: What He has entrusted or granted to you as a possession or responsibility

ai.seo_question: What does Imam 'Ali عليه السلام mean by al-'ujm among your possessions?
ai.summary: Imam 'Ali عليه السلام instructs believers to have taqwa concerning the blessings and property Allah has placed in their care, including mute animals among their possessions. When asked about the meaning of al-'ujm, he explains that it refers to animals such as sheep, cattle, pigeons, and similar creatures, highlighting responsibility toward them.
